subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw handle Volcano Engine Lite/Coding Plan keys that pass setup but fail on the general `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201` route with a key-format 401?
rationale: Source inspection shows a plausible current mismatch, but changing provider routing or diagnostics without live entitlement proof could break the documented general-vs-coding split for existing Volcengine users.

options.title: Require live route proof first
options.body: Use a credentialed Lite/Coding Plan key to test the general DeepSeek route and coding route, then make the plugin catalog or diagnostic change that matches the observed vendor contract.

options.title: Keep the documented split
options.body: Leave routing as-is and improve docs or diagnostics only if maintainers decide Lite keys are not expected to work with general Volcengine DeepSeek rows.

options.title: Reroute Lite users to coding models
options.body: Change defaults or catalog guidance toward `volcengine-plan` if maintainers already know Lite keys are coding-endpoint-only and can accept the compatibility impact.

recommendation.title: Require live route proof first
recommendation.body: Use a credentialed Lite/Coding Plan key to test the general DeepSeek route and coding route, then make the plugin catalog or diagnostic change that matches the observed vendor contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Provider auth aliases and setup-routing policy are central to the decision, and steipete has the clearest adjacent history in the auth alias path.
